_note: Copy to secrets.json and fill in. All free, all optional except acoustid_key -- without it fingerprint identification is skipped and the pipeline falls back to text search. chmod 600 the copy.
contact: you@example.com  (or a URL) -- MusicBrainz requires a reachable contact in the User-Agent; leave blank to use the project URL
acoustid_user_key: optional, giving back only. Your personal key from https://acoustid.org/api-key once signed in, which is a different thing from acoustid_key: that one identifies Muzzi, this one identifies you as the submitter. pipeline/giveback.py refuses to send without it.
genius_client_secret: issued with the Genius client id
deezer_arl: optional, timed lyrics. Log in to deezer.com on a free account, then copy the `arl` cookie (192 hex characters). Unofficial and it expires when you log out, so pipeline/health.py probes it and says so rather than reporting no lyrics.
